parameters.name: xs
parameters.semantics: A finite OCaml list of opaque elements.

result.semantics: For input [x1; ...; xn], returns [x1; x1; ...; xn; xn], preserving left-to-right order and every occurrence.

generic_supporting_primitives: OCaml list constructors [] and (::) after mechanical lowering
Synquid built-in List, Nil, and Cons datatype support
trusted_primitive_declarations.note: No List.rev, List.length, list equality, comparison, external call, or pre-written target/helper algorithm is admitted as a synthesis component.

finite_domain: The benchmark contract is for ordinary finite OCaml lists only.
